# Crux Resolve LLC

> Crux Resolve LLC is a veteran-owned small business in Illinois, USA, building practical software and hardware for vehicle, embedded, and serial-connected systems. GhostTune is the company's mobile ECU tuning software, and GhostBridge is its wireless interface hardware family.

Official website: https://cruxresolve.com/
Support: https://cruxresolve.com/support.html
Contact: support@cruxresolve.com

## GhostTune

GhostTune is an independent ECU tuning application for iPhone and iPad published by Crux Resolve LLC.

- Current product page: https://cruxresolve.com/ghosttune-app.html
- Apple App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id6778061607
- Current verified ECU configuration: MicroSquirt hardware running MS2/Extra 3.4.4.
- Live ECU communication uses a compatible local WiFi-to-RS232 bridge.
- Core functions include VE, ignition, and AFR table editing, live ECU data, tune-file management and backups, diagnostics, guarded temporary writes, permanent burns, and read-back verification.
- Demo Mode can be used without a connected ECU.
- Additional ECU platforms are not considered supported unless Crux Resolve explicitly lists them as verified.

## GhostBridge

GhostBridge is the Crux Resolve wireless interface hardware family.

- Current product page: https://cruxresolve.com/ghostbridge.html
- GhostBridge v1.0 / GB-01 is the currently available assembled product.
- GB-01 is a local RS232-to-WiFi TCP bridge with DB9 RS232 and USB-C power.
- Default local TCP endpoint: 192.168.4.1:35000.
- GB-01 is optimized and verified for the published GhostTune + MicroSquirt / MS2/Extra 3.4.4 workflow.
- GB-01 acts as a transparent TCP-to-RS232 transport and does not itself interpret ECU calibration data.
- Other RS232 applications may be compatible only when their electrical, pinout, serial, TCP-client, and software requirements match.
- GhostBridge v2.0 / GB-02 is a development project and should not be described as a shipping product unless the current product page says otherwise.

## Brand and relationship notes

Crux Resolve LLC is the company and publisher/manufacturer. GhostTune and GhostBridge are product families owned and developed under Crux Resolve.

GhostTune and GhostBridge are independent products. References to MicroSquirt, MegaSquirt, MS2/Extra, Apple, iPhone, iPad, iOS, or App Store identify compatible or relevant third-party products, platforms, or trademarks and do not imply endorsement or affiliation.
